The screen content stays inside the glowing border and never rises above the top rail; the desk reflection follows the screen; nothing else in the studio changes. At same time The anchor says exactly, in natural English, at a natural, unhurried pace, in an authoritative and informative news presenter tone, clear and easy to understand, never rushed, positive: "Welcome to A I News Desk.
